item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

style.prompt: Charming cinematic 3D animation in warm sunlight. A small friendly metal robot in a tranquil garden gently tilts a watering can to water a single colorful flower in a terracotta pot. A clear stream of water lands on the soil, and the flower gently sways. Medium shot with a subtle slow camera push in, coherent continuous action, warm and tender mood. No on-screen words, titles, or subtitles. Silent.
